Animals from the continent of [[Seanchan]]. With the animals descriptions - aside from the S'redit - we can come to the assumption that they are representations of ancient animals like Dinosaurs and Pterosaurs for a modern world excavation of fossils.

Animals like the Corlm bear a striking resemblance to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phorusrhacidae Phorusrhacids]'' ''or "Terror birds", this likely hints at Seanchan having more of the Mirror World Animals that we today call Dinosaurs in their list of exotica.
